milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate close to the acacia button on the exterior wall and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. Target is the button at spawn-relative (5, 2, 6). max_distance=8 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance since the button is on the exterior and visible from the approach path. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the button.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must enter the hut and get close to the potted acacia sapling on the floor, facing toward it. Target is the sapling at spawn-relative (7, 1, 9). max_distance=5 is used because the interior is small (~5x5 blocks) so the player must be inside or at the doorway to be this close. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the sapling.
